newsitem.title: FRANCE: Trading in shares of France's GAN suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in shares of France's GAN suspended.

text.p: Share trading in state-controlled insurer Groupe des Assurances Nationales were suspended four times in a row on the Paris bourse on Friday and would requote only if they stayed under a ceiling of 149.10 francs, the SBF stock markets association said.

The shares were suspended at 123 francs on Thursday ahead of a government announcement of a state rescue package costing up to 20 billion french francs ($3.51 billion) to shore up the company's accounts after 35 billion francs of losses since 1992.
Several attempts to requote were abandoned after the share price repeatedly breached limits triggering a halt in trading.
